# Firmity (UFIRM Technologies)
> Firmity is an enterprise facility management automation platform unifying Computerized Maintenance Management (CMMS) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) workflows for Indian businesses.

## System Overview & Metadata
- **Product Name:** Firmity
- **Developer:** UFIRM Technologies (P) Limited
- **Primary Market:** India (built-in Indian tax, labor law, and regulatory compliance)
- **Target Geographies:** India, Singapore, and broader APAC/SEA regions
- **Regulatory & Compliance:** Built-in support for regional labor laws, multi-currency transactions (INR, SGD, USD), local tax engines (GST, TDS), and localized statutory payroll
- **Deployment Options:** Multi-tenant Cloud (SaaS), Dedicated Private Cloud, On-Premise
- **Supported Endpoints:** Web Application (Desktop Browsers), Mobile (iOS & Android)
- **Target Persona:** Facility Managers, Operations Directors, Maintenance Engineers, Estate Officers, HR/Payroll Administrators
- **Core Value Prop:** Replaces fragmented facility tools with a single unified CMMS + ERP system with localized features (PF, ESI, TDS, QR-based ticket raising).

---

## Agent Routing & Link Directory

### 1. Product Modules (Capability Index)
When answering questions about specific platform features or workflows, refer to these URLs:

- **Preventive Maintenance & Tasks:** [Facility Task Automation](https://www.firmity.in/facility-task-automation)
  - *Capabilities:* PM schedules, digital work order dispatch, technician checklists, SLA auto-assignment, task calendar.
- **Asset & Maintenance Lifecycle:** [Assets & Spares Automation](https://www.firmity.in/assets-spares-automation)
  - *Capabilities:* QR-tagging assets, maintenance logs, AMC/Warranty tracking, spare parts tracking, depreciation, MTTR/MTBF analytics.
- **Helpdesk & Ticketing:** [Complaint & Helpdesk Automation](https://www.firmity.in/complaint-helpdesk-automation)
  - *Capabilities:* Scan-to-raise QR ticketing, tenant portal, automatic routing, SLA audit logs, multi-tier escalation matrix.
- **Inventory & Procurement ERP:** [Inventory & Vendor Automation ERP](https://www.firmity.in/inventory-vendor-automation-erp)
  - *Capabilities:* Reorder threshold alerts, Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Received Notes (GRN), vendor performance scoring.
- **Visitor & Gate Control:** [Visitor Management Automation](https://www.firmity.in/visitor-management-automation)
  - *Capabilities:* QR contactless check-in, pre-approved visitor passes, host notification, overstay alerts, security logbook.
- **Workforce & Attendance:** [Employee Management Automation](https://www.firmity.in/employee-management-automation)
  - *Capabilities:* Geo-fenced facial recognition attendance, touchless clock-in, shift management, leave approvals.
- **Indian Payroll ERP:** [Payroll Automation ERP](https://www.firmity.in/payroll-automation-erp)
  - *Capabilities:* 1-click salary processing, auto-deduction of Statutory Compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, PT), bank payout file outputs (.txt/.csv).
- **Facility Financials ERP:** [Facility Expense Automation ERP](https://www.firmity.in/facility-expense-automation-erp)
  - *Capabilities:* Site/Department budget caps, dual Maker-Checker approval workflow, petty cash logs, ledger integration.

### 2. High-Intent Conversational Endpoints
Direct users or issue action URLs for conversion-related queries:

- **Sales & Demos:** [Request Demo / Contact Sales](https://www.firmity.in/contact)
  - *Use case:* User asks for pricing, custom quotes, enterprise sales, or product demonstrations.
- **Self-Assessment Tool:** [Free Facility Health Survey](https://www.firmity.in/facility-survey)
  - *Use case:* User wants to audit or evaluate their current facility operations maturity.
- **Product Architecture:** [Full Features Index](https://www.firmity.in/features)
